items.title: Missed Illumina's 76% Run? Here Is What Holders Saw
items.summary: If Illumina sat on your watchlist instead of in your portfolio, the past year might feel like a missed shot. Investors who held Illumina over the past year are up 76.2%, including dividends. That outcome arrived alongside headlines about NovaSeq X uptake, clinical sequencing demand, and moves into multiomics. items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Unveils Duplex Sequencing Workflow For MRD Research
items.summary: Illumina (NasdaqGS:ILMN) has expanded its molecular residual disease research portfolio with an ultrasensitive duplex sequencing workflow for circulating tumor DNA. The company introduced an industry-level duplex sequencing approach designed to increase sensitivity in detecting molecular residual disease signals in cancer research. Illumina was selected to provide whole-genome sequencing services for Singapore's SG-INSIGHT national precision medicine study. Beyond the duplex MRD expansion...
